facts.text: PathwayOregon ensures that academically qualified, federal Pell Grant-eligible Oregonians have their tuition and fees paid through federal, state, and university funds.
Through the Oregon Guarantee, each University of Oregon student gets a fixed tuition rate for up to five years.

sources.title: Undergraduate Tuition and Fees | Lundquist College of Business

facts.text: The PathwayOregon program guarantees full tuition and fees along with academic support for qualifying Oregon residents.
